note: Cooling alarms (docs/02 C.7). Thresholds chosen 2026-11-14 for the owner's car, not Toyota figures: tune them here from HybridDash logs. Engine water pump: confirmed 2019 (700 22 1043, 0 with the engine stopped, 1500-2900 rpm running, target 25-125 rpm above actual, docs/02 C8 in HybridLogger). The engine ECU sets P261B below about 900 rpm (owner reports), but owners also report pumps that stop or lose their impeller without any code, hence the coolant checks as well. Inverter water pump (profile 9): confirmed 2019, 7D2 22 1039 bytes 2-3 in rpm (HybridLogger profile 15, docs/02 C13 there); it runs whenever the car is READY, engine running or not: 3432-3485 rpm with the inverter coolant from 16 C, about 4250-4300 rpm below about 15 C, 160 rpm before READY. No target speed is readable (the duty 7D2 22 1112 is refused), so its checks use fixed speeds well below anything logged in READY. Not logged yet: long drives and a hot inverter; if the pump ever runs below 2500 rpm on a healthy car, lower the caution. The inverter coolant checks stay: they also catch a pump that turns but moves no water. HybridGuard 2026-11-23: the last three checks (HV battery, motor inverter, 12 V) are optional, off by default, with thresholds chosen as a starting point, not Toyota figures; the driver switches them on and tunes every number in the app. The oil check was removed on 2026-11-23: this car gives no oil temperature (docs/02), so the coolant checks cover the engine.
